title: Entity registry
description: config/schema/entities.yml: every entity of the configuration — where its records are stored, the schema its files satisfy and its relationships to other entities. tools/check.py reads it.

relation.description: A reference from a field of this entity's records (from: a dotted path, * every item or value, *keys every key) to the ids of another entity, or a named rule tools/check.py implements

format.description: How the value names its target: plain (the id), versioned (<id>[<constraint>]), record_id (an id or {id: ...})

why.description: What the relationship is used for
What the entity is and what uses it

files.description: Repository-relative glob of its files (* within one path segment)

root.description: The key under which a file's record or records sit (dotted for a nested list: Family.chips); absent: the whole document is the record

records.description: How records sit under the root: one, a list, or a mapping keyed by id

id.description: The field that identifies a record (absent for a map: the key; for one record without an id field: the file name)

file_named_after_id.description: One record per file, the file named <id>.yml

schema.description: The JSON Schema (config/schema/) every file satisfies; null while the entity's files are still being reshaped

record_schema.description: For an entity whose records sit inside another entity's files (chips in a family file): the JSON Schema every record satisfies

no_schema_because.description: Why there is no schema yet
